cs.t: The microsoft internet keyboard has all the trappings of the perfect keyboard. (except it is not USB.) The arrow keys are in the preferred upside down tee, it has a huge delete button, the home and end keys are in the correct logical left to right order, the page up and page down are in the correct up and down configuration. Split keys are there for ergonomics and it is fairly cheap.  http://www.google.com/products/catalog?hl=en&safe=off&#3...  I don't know about those sellers but that is the keyboard that I love.
